nodes.label: 30-day Readmission Risk for Diabetic Inpatients
nodes.author: Muhammad TALHA, Jules BORDAIS, Elimane DIALLO

nodes.label: Cohort Exclusion of Death/Hospice Discharges
nodes.rationale: Patients who died or went to hospice cannot be readmitted

nodes.label: Business Costs (cost_fn=5, cost_fp=1, review_capacity=0.20)
nodes.rationale: FN = unplanned bed + emergency workload; FP = one follow-up call / provisional bed hold

nodes.label: Feature Settings (drop list, min_category_count, target encoding)
nodes.norm_label: feature settings (drop list, min_category_count, target encoding)
nodes.rationale: race dropped from inputs but kept as sensitive attribute; rare categories (<50) pooled per fold

nodes.label: selection_metric: average_precision
nodes.rationale: PR-AUC is the course metric for rare positives

nodes.label: Binary Target: Readmitted <30 Days
nodes.rationale: Bed-management use case: discharge team plans beds and targets follow-up calls; prevalence 11.4%

nodes.label: CatBoost (Final Model)
nodes.rationale: Best CV AP 0.248; test AP 0.239, ROC-AUC 0.683, Brier 0.095, ECE 0.006

nodes.label: Class Weights and Resampling Finding
nodes.rationale: Did not improve AP and degraded Brier (0.095 -> 0.20 with weight 7.8)

nodes.label: Cost-Based Decision Threshold (0.175)
nodes.rationale: Chosen on dev with C_FN = 5 x C_FP; flags 15.4%, recall 33.6%, precision 24.9%, cost -13% vs flagging nobody

nodes.label: Equal-Opportunity Fairness Audit with Group Thresholds
nodes.norm_label: equal-opportunity fairness audit with group thresholds
nodes.rationale: Group thresholds cut TPR gap from 0.29 to 0.13 at no cost; gap mostly driven by small Unknown group

nodes.label: Probability Calibration (Platt/Isotonic)
nodes.rationale: No recalibration needed: 2,258 expected vs 2,263 observed readmissions

nodes.label: Central Configuration (config.yaml)
nodes.rationale: Every script reads this file so each choice is made once

nodes.label: All Learned Preprocessing Inside the Pipeline
nodes.norm_label: all learned preprocessing inside the pipeline
nodes.rationale: Rare-category pooling, imputation, scaling, one-hot, cross-fitted target encoding and resampling refit per fold to avoid leakage

nodes.label: Race as Audited Sensitive Attribute
nodes.rationale: Kept for the fairness audit but never a model input

nodes.label: Single Untouched Test Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Test set used once in 04_finalize.py after model, calibrator and threshold are frozen

nodes.label: Comparison of at Least Three Models
nodes.norm_label: comparison of at least three models

nodes.label: End-to-End Supervised Learning Proof of Concept
nodes.norm_label: end-to-end supervised learning proof of concept
nodes.rationale: Build and defend a complete supervised-learning proof of concept on a tabular binary classification problem, from raw data to a served prediction endpoint.

nodes.label: Patient-Disjoint StratifiedGroupKFold Split
nodes.rationale: No patient on both sides of a split, preventing leakage across 80/20 dev/test and 5 CV folds
